exposure: COVID-19 infection during pregnancy (first trimester diagnosis)
COVID-19 infection during pregnancy (second trimester diagnosis)
COVID-19 infection during pregnancy (third trimester diagnosis)
cohort: The study included 224 pregnant women with confirmed antenatal COVID-19 infections managed at a tertiary hospital.
finding: COVID-19 infection diagnosed in the third trimester led to significantly higher neonatal ICU admissions compared to first-trimester diagnosis, and lower Apgar scores at 1 and 5 minutes compared to second-trimester diagnosis.
mod_finding: No significant differences were observed in cesarean section indications related to the trimester of COVID-19 infection.
